target_band.cite: Half the spread of the bull case priced on P/FCF re-rating 7.3x to its 5y min 10.6x (factsheet Valuation table) on flat TTM FCF/share ($13.45 from the 13.70% FCF yield, factsheet ST) = $142.56, vs. the same re-rate logic applied to EV/EBITDA (10.9x to its 5y min 15.7x) and EV/Sales (3.0x to its 5y min 3.5x), both on flat TTM EBITDA/share ($10.92) and revenue/share ($39.68) implied from EV/EBITDA, EV/Sales and net debt/EBITDA 1.91x (factsheet RA/ST, market cap 12.5bn/price 98.18 -> 127.3m shares), giving $150.60 and $118.02 respectively; spread $32.58 / 2 / $142 target = 11.47% (P/E's 5y min of 10.9x is below the current 14.6x, so it cannot support a bull re-rate and is excluded as an anchor)

target_band.cite: Base case is a single-anchor story (partial P/FCF re-rate from 7.3x toward the 10.6x floor, factsheet RA, plus the 6.24% buyback growth, factsheet ST): applying the same per-share growth and the same proportional multiple expansion (10.2%) to P/E and EV/EBITDA converges on $114.9-$117.3 (within ~2% of $115, i.e. rounding/assumption noise, not a genuine cross-anchor disagreement), so band = 0
